title: Corvale Transit Authority: cost review board readout

cover.title: Corvale Transit Authority: six initiatives to fund service growth
cover.sub: Findings of the operating cost review and the proposed workplan.

exec.title: The review found {rr} of run-rate savings, {pct} of operating cost, with no cut to service hours

rows.p: Service hours must grow {hrs} by FY29 to meet ridership targets, while operating funding is flat in real terms. Without savings the gap reaches the size of one bus division.
Maintenance planning and procurement carry over half the savings; no initiative reduces service on the street. Each has a named owner and a baseline agreed with finance.
The board is asked to approve {cost} of one-time cost and a four-phase workplan, with a progress report at every second board meeting.
